I'll analyze EVAL-01 for security threats using STRIDE methodology. Let me build the threat model based on the context provided.

The design describes a mobile banking app that stores refresh tokens in plaintext and uses biometrics only as a UI unlock mechanism. This presents several critical security vulnerabilities.

      "component": "Token lifecycle management",
